skill.name: workhub
skill.description: Workhub organizes project documentation, issues, and PR records under a docs folder using a single source of truth workflow.
skill.summary: Manage docs, issue plans, PR records, and project status from a structured docs workspace.
skill.author: Dwsy

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, TypeScript template strings, documented ~/.pi install paths, and readable Chinese Markdown. One high-confidence semantic issue remains: user-controlled paths can escape the intended docs directories during read or create operations.

remediation.issue: User-controlled paths are joined without containment checks.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve each target path, compare it against the allowed docs subdirectory, and reject paths that escape the boundary.

remediation.issue: Issue and PR names can include path separators or traversal tokens.
remediation.suggestion: Validate category and description values with an allowlist for safe filename characters before creating files.

remediation.issue: Documentation examples encourage fixed home-directory skill paths.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer installer-provided command names or environment variables in docs to reduce hidden-directory confusion.

description: 工作文档枢纽,强制执行 SSOT(Single Source of Truth)原则,管理 `docs/` 目录下的架构决策、设计文档、Issues(任务规划)、PRs(变更
| **项目文档目录** | `./docs/` | **工作目录** (执行命令时的当前目录) |
- `issues/` 和 `pr/` 目录可以包含子目录分类
- 如果项目规模较小,可以直接在 `issues/` 和 `pr/` 根目录下创建文件
检查 `docs/` 文件夹是否遵循标准文档治理规范。
- 需要时通过 `workhub read` 读取
| `read` | 读取文档 | `~/.pi/agent/skills/workhub/lib.ts read issues/20250106-添加深色模式.md` |
| `create issue` | 创建 Issue | `~/.pi/agent/skills/workhub/lib.ts create issue "添加深色模式" 前端` |
| `create pr` | 创建 PR | `~/.pi/agent/skills/workhub/lib.ts create pr "修复登录bug" 后端` |
| `list issues` | 列出所有 Issues | `~/.pi/agent/skills/workhub/lib.ts list issues` |
| `list prs` | 列出所有 PRs | `~/.pi/agent/skills/workhub/lib.ts list prs` |
| `search` | 搜索内容 | `~/.pi/agent/skills/workhub/lib.ts search "深色模式"` |

content.value_statement: Project work often spreads across chats, tasks, and pull requests. Workhub keeps issues, PR records, decisions, and status in one docs folder.
actual_capabilities: Initializes a standard docs folder with architecture, ADR, issues, and PR directories.
Creates issue and PR Markdown files from bundled templates.
Lists issue and PR files and extracts their visible status markers.
Reads selected Markdown documents from the project docs folder.
Searches issue and PR Markdown content for a keyword.
Prints a combined status view for issues and PR records.
limitations: It works on local Markdown files and does not sync with GitHub automatically.
It expects a docs folder in the current project directory.
It does not validate Markdown content beyond simple directory checks.
Current path handling needs stronger validation before broad marketplace use.

use_cases.title: Plan Engineering Tasks
use_cases.description: Create structured issue files with goals, phases, acceptance criteria, and status notes before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Record Pull Request Context
use_cases.description: Create PR records that capture why a change was made, what changed, test results, and rollback plans.

use_cases.title: Maintain Project Memory
use_cases.description: Read, search, and update project documentation so work context stays in files instead of conversation history.

prompt_templates.title: Initialize Work Docs
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Workhub to initialize a docs workspace for this project. Then show the directory structure and explain what each top-level folder stores.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Issue Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Workhub to create an issue for the requested feature. Include a clear goal, phased tasks, acceptance criteria, and risk notes.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Current Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Workhub to list open issues and PR records. Summarize current status, blockers, completed items, and missing follow-up work.

prompt_templates.title: Trace Change History
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Workhub to search the docs for a feature name. Connect related issues, PR records, decisions, tests, and rollback notes into one summary.

output_examples.input: Create an issue for adding dark mode to the frontend.
output_examples.output: Workhub creates a dated issue file under docs/issues. The file includes goal, background, acceptance criteria, phases, decisions, errors, resources, and status history.
Workhub lists issue and PR records, shows each detected status marker, and reports the total number of tracked items.

output_examples.input: Find all records related to release cleanup.
output_examples.output: Workhub searches issue and PR Markdown files and returns matching files with short line excerpts for review.

best_practices: Run Workhub from the project root so docs are created in the intended workspace.
Keep each issue focused on one goal with measurable acceptance criteria.
Link every PR record back to the issue or decision that explains the change.
anti_patterns: Do not use Workhub as a secret store or credentials notebook.
Do not create vague issue files without goals, owners, or validation steps.
Do not rely on status summaries without reviewing the underlying Markdown records.

faq.question: Does Workhub connect to GitHub?
faq.answer: No. It creates local Markdown files that follow GitHub-style issue and PR workflows.

faq.question: Where does it store project records?
faq.answer: It stores records under the docs folder in the current working project.

faq.question: Can it create issue and PR templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It copies bundled Markdown templates into the correct issue or PR folder.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it inspect code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It manages documentation files and simple status summaries. It does not perform code analysis.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive files?
faq.answer: It should not be used for secrets. Path validation should be improved before broad use.
